comment: Independent witness for mkobj.c obj_extract_self() on a freed object reached from trap.c trapeffect_poly_trap(). A wished polymorph trap lies beside the Priest; the dwarf wearing iron shoes follows the hero across it, so zap.c poly_obj() turns the shoes into kicking boots, and mkobj.c replace_object() leaves the old shoes free with a stale ocarry, the union member that nexthere aliases, before delobj() frees them.
